chunks: Abdullah ibn Ja‘far and Sa‘d ibn Abdullah, both together, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Habib al-Sijistani, who said:

I heard Abu Ja‘far (عليه السلام) saying: Fatimah, the daughter of Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وآله), was born five years after the mission of the Messenger of Allah, and she passed away when she was eighteen years and seventy-five days old.

key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ: Fatimah, daughter of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله)
key_terms.مَبْعَثِ: the beginning of the prophetic mission

ai.seo_question: When was Fatimah bint Muhammad (عليها السلام) born, and how old was she when she passed away?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the birth date of Fatimah bint Muhammad (عليها السلام) as five years after the beginning of the Prophet’s mission, and states her age at death. It is a concise biographical report preserving a historical detail about the daughter of the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله).
